sources: Quaternius, Ultimate Animated Animal Pack: Cow.gltf (from https://pixeltriks.com). https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
A pig of Việt Nam (lợn Móng Cái): about 60 cm at the shoulder, a long and wide body, short legs, a black head and back, a white belly and white legs.

A Móng Cái pig: a breed of the north of Việt Nam, about 60 cm at the shoulder; a black head and a black saddle on the back, a white belly and white legs. The template is a cow without horns; the numbers of the shape are a guess from photos.
